drhp.business: Powerica manufactures and supplies DG sets (7.5-3,750 kVA) powered by Cummins engines as a long-standing Cummins OEM, and medium-speed large generators (3,000-10,000 kVA) in collaboration with Hyundai, plus allied products (EMI shelters, acoustic enclosures, Schneider PRISMA panels). Since 2008 it also operates a Wind Power Business as an independent power producer (330.85 MW operational in Gujarat) and provides EPC and O&M services for balance-of-plant. Generator Set Business is ~80-86% of revenue.
drhp.end_markets: Commercial (hospitality, healthcare, BFSI, education, real estate)|Infrastructure (retail, logistics, railways, metros)|Manufacturing/process industries, dairy|Agriculture (cold storage, aquaculture)|IT/data centres|Government and defence|Rentals|State/central distribution utilities (wind power)
drhp.expansion: Constructing Orchid Phase II (52.70 MW, SECI Wind Tranche-XVII, tariff Rs 3.81/kWh, SCOD March 1, 2027) to take IPP portfolio to 383.55 MW; pipeline of Project Alpha (50 MW), Project Beta (100 MW wind + 30 MW solar), Project Gama (100 MW) in Gujarat (won GUVNL Phase X bids at Rs 3.44 and Rs 3.43/kWh). Executing MSLG orders: 63 MW for NPCIL and 10 MW EDG for an Australian fertiliser plant.

market_size.metric: India wind energy potential at 150m AGL (NIWE)

sk.overview: Powerica operates across two industries: (1) India's standby power / diesel-generator (DG set) market, where DG sets, UPS, inverters and battery storage provide backup power during outages/voltage fluctuations across commercial, manufacturing, IT/data-centre, telecom and infrastructure sectors (F&S Report); and (2) India's wind power sector within the broader renewable energy industry, where wind plays a pivotal role in the country's energy transition (CRISIL Report).
sk.schemes: SECI wind auctions (Tranche-XVII)|GUVNL state wind auctions (Phase X)
sk.structure: DG sets classified by capacity: LHP (7.5-160 kVA), MHP (180-500 kVA), HHP (>500 kVA); MSLG sets 3-10 MW for continuous/base-load. Wind potential concentrated in five states: Rajasthan (24%), Gujarat (16%), Maharashtra (15%), Karnataka (15%), Andhra Pradesh (11%).
